sections.text_preview: The challenge of designing an interleaved receiver with wide bandwidth and 4-bit accuracy is met by using fast sample–hold amplifiers, small transistors to minimize input capacitance, and offset calibration. sections.title: TRANSMITTER
sections.text_preview: The transmitter uses eight interleaved DACs. Each 8-bit DAC uses a current-steering architecture with an array of current sources (Fig. 9). To improve linearity without significant area overhead, the eight bits are divided into three bits (MSB) of thermometer encoded data and five bits (LSB) of binary data. sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: This work demonstrates the feasibility of transmitting and receiving data with interleaved ADCs and DACs that operate at 8 GSamples/s. This opens the door to more complex signaling and equalization to increase link bit rates in band-limited transmission channels.
